description: An expander that reads and writes single cells of a neighbouring module's memory at addresses given as voltages, placed immediately to the left of the module it reaches into

params.text: Chooses which of the host's memory channels to work on, 0 to 16; the lamp is green while that channel is there and red while it is not
Scales the data input, and sets the value written on its own while nothing is patched to the data jack, -10V to 10V
Chooses when a write happens: while the write jack reads above 0.5V, on every sample whatever it reads, or once on each rising edge at that jack

inputs.text: Sets the X part of the address, 0V to 10V across the width of the memory; every channel patched here is a separate address
Sets the Y part of the address, 0V to 10V down the height of the memory; every channel patched here is a separate address
The value to write, through the data trimpot; its channels are written to the addresses in turn, and the last channel is reused for any addresses beyond it
Says when to write, read in the way the write switch is set; a single channel here writes every address at once

outputs.text: The values stored at the addresses being read, one channel for each address

notes: this module does nothing on its own: it works on the memory of a DMA-compatible module placed immediately to its right, which means RAM-40964, Microcosm or Dual Integrator
nothing is read or written until the X or Y jack is patched: with both empty no address is worked out, the output carries no channels and no write takes place
on a memory of on-and-off cells a write of more than 0.5V turns a cell on and anything lower turns it off, and the output reads 1V for on and 0V for off

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads cell 0; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads cell 0; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.2:
±10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the data trimpot.
inputs.3:
high above 0.5V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads no write happens; a negative voltage does nothing here.
